product.description: Monoprice™Entegrade Series Cat8 RJ45 Tool-less Shielded Modular Plug for Round 22–24AWG Solid Wire Ethernet Cable, 40Gbps, Gold-Plated RJ45 ContactsBuild high-performance Cat8 Ethernet cables faster and more efficiently with the Monoprice Entegrade Series Cat8 RJ45 Tool-less Shielded Modular Plug. Designed for round 22–24AWG solid wire Ethernet cable, this field-installable plug simplifies custom cable assembly by eliminating the need for a traditional crimping process. The tool-less design streamlines termination in professional networking environments while supporting clean, consistent results. Engineered for high-speed connectivity up to 40Gbps, this shielded modular plug is a trusty solution for demanding network applications where performance and reliability matter. Gold-plated RJ45 contacts help maintain dependable connectivity over time, while support for both T568A and T568B wiring standards adds installation flexibility.
